title: rosa majalis var. globosa
intro: Rosa majalis var. globosa, commonly known as the globular rose or Rosa majalis, is a type of rose plant that is native to Europe and Western Asia. It is a shrub that produces small, pale pink to white flowers and is valued for its ornamental and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Rosa majalis var. globosa include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and astringent, and its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils that contribute to its medicinal properties.
